# StudyBuddy — Study Planner

Responsive single-page study planner prototype created for Module 2 Sessions 6–10.

## Features
- Subject and future exam-date validation
- Daily study-time selection
- Demo day-by-day revision plan
- Responsive mobile layout
- Reset button

**Important:** This is a front-end prototype. No real AI model or external API is connected. The plan is generated by simple demo logic. No form data is sent to a server.

## Deploy
Import this repository into Vercel and deploy it as a static site. The entry file is `index.html`.
